name: Interview with a Killer
source:
You have been given the opportunity to interview a serial killer in order to understand the reasoning behind his crimes, as well as every little detail that he has refused to tell the rest of the public in order to obtain the first page of the newspaper you work for!

[From [url=https://naedoesgames.itch.io/interview-with-a-killer]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你有机会采访一个连环杀手，以了解他犯罪背后的原因，以及他拒绝告诉其他公众的每一个小细节，以获得你工作的报纸的头版！

[来自[url=https://naedoesgames.itch.io/interview-with-a-killer]itch.io[/url]]
